name: Sill
author: Fernando Menolli
description: A shelf on the bar. Drop files on it from anywhere, carry them across workspaces, and paste them where they belong.

barWidget.description: Drag files onto the bar to set them down, then copy them out wherever you need them. Nothing is moved or duplicated on disk — the shelf holds references.

schema.label: Open the shelf when a drag reaches the bar
schema.description: Gives you the whole panel to drop into instead of the icon.

schema.label: Empty the shelf after copying everything
Set a screenshot down as soon as it is taken
schema.description: A screenshot already goes to the clipboard, but the clipboard holds one thing. Turn this on when you take three of them for the same message.
